paras: A minimum-wage worker needs almost THREE YEARS to earn what GTA 6 made in ONE second.
On day one, GTA 6 made about forty-three thousand dollars. Every. Single. Second.
The US federal minimum wage? Seven twenty-five an hour. It hasn't gone up since two thousand nine.
Forty-three thousand eight hundred sixty-five, divided by seven twenty-five. That's six thousand and fifty hours of work.
Forty hours a week, no vacation. That's almost three years.
GTA 6 did it in one second.
Tag someone who's still at work. And follow for more money facts.
